title: Groundwater Drop

items.label: Lower Well
items.description: A farmer lowers a rope farther into a well before reaching water.

items.local_cue: Barind area near Rajshahi, with reddish dry soil, small crop plots, tubewell equipment and modest farm buildings. In this cutout specifically, make the decisive evidence prominent: a rope lowered deep into a well before its bucket reaches water

questions: Which two scenes show water becoming harder to reach?
How do people you know manage water in the dry season?
Should water go first to drinking needs or crop irrigation? Why?
Why might a farmer keep pumping even as the water level falls?
If pumping is reduced quickly, what happens to a farmer’s income?
You have 1,000,000 BDT and 30 days. What one water-saving pilot would your grant test?

grant.pilot_scope: Trial water-saving irrigation or surface-water storage with one farmer group; do not promise to restore the aquifer in 30 days.
